title: Connecting sentences
intro: The words that turn a list of sentences into prose. Most are invariable and cost nothing to learn, and they do more for how fluent you sound than any amount of vocabulary.

entries.note: tampoco is the negative twin. Yo tampoco means me neither.

ex.en: I want to go too.
I didn't like the ending either.

entries.note: además de means as well as, in addition to.

ex.es: Es caro y además está lejos.
ex.en: It's expensive, and what's more it's far away.

entries.note: The formal but. no obstante is a heavier version.

ex.es: Es difícil; sin embargo, vale la pena.
ex.en: It's hard; however, it's worth it.

entries.he: אף על פי ש- / גם אם
entries.note: With the indicative it means although; with the subjunctive, even if.

ex.en: Although it's raining, we're going out.
Even if it rains, we'll go out.
So are you coming or not?
At that time we lived in Lima.

entries.note: por lo tanto is the formal version.

ex.en: It was raining, that's why we didn't go out.

entries.en: that is to say, in other words
entries.note: o sea does the same job and is far commoner in speech.

ex.es: Llegó tarde, es decir, perdimos el tren.
ex.en: He arrived late — in other words, we missed the train.

entries.note: The great filler of spoken Spanish, roughly English like or I mean.

ex.es: Está cerca, o sea, unos diez minutos.
ex.en: It's close — I mean, about ten minutes.

ex.es: Trae algo dulce, por ejemplo fruta.
ex.en: Bring something sweet, for example fruit.

entries.note: Marks a contrast between two subjects. Different from el cambio, change — see unit 18.

ex.es: Él es callado; ella, en cambio, habla muchísimo.
ex.en: He's quiet; she, on the other hand, talks a lot.

entries.note: mientras for simultaneous time, mientras que for contrast.

ex.en: I cook while I listen to the radio.

ex.es: Yo pago, mientras que ella no paga nada.
ex.en: I pay, whereas she pays nothing.

entries.note: finalmente is the neutral word; por fin carries relief.

ex.en: You're here at last!

entries.note: Two words. One word, el sobretodo, is an overcoat.

ex.es: Me gusta la fruta, sobre todo el mango.
ex.en: I like fruit, especially mango.

entries.note: de todas maneras and de todas formas mean the same.

ex.es: De todos modos, gracias por avisar.
ex.en: Anyway, thanks for letting me know.

entries.note: a pesar de que + clause: a pesar de que llovía.

ex.en: We went out in spite of the cold.

ex.es: Según el periódico, ganó el otro equipo.
ex.en: According to the paper, the other team won.
We'll leave depending on the weather.

entries.note: Not to be confused with en cuanto, which means as soon as.

ex.es: En cuanto al dinero, ya lo resolvimos.
ex.en: As for the money, we've sorted it out.

entries.note: ni ... ni is neither ... nor. ni siquiera intensifies it.

ex.es: No come ni carne ni pescado.
ex.en: He eats neither meat nor fish.
He didn't even say hello.

entries.note: Becomes u before a word starting with o: siete u ocho. The same rule turns y into e before i: padre e hijo.

ex.es: Tráeme siete u ocho, no importa.
ex.en: Bring me seven or eight, it doesn't matter.

entries.note: así es means that's right; así que means so, therefore.

ex.en: Do it like this.
It was closed, so we came back.
